title: DomainEvent
description: Canonical envelope for agentic-claims-alpha domain events (ADR-0005). The payload is validated against the per-eventType payload schema emitted from the Fabric IQ wedge ontology (the convergence seam). Supersedes the example-only enums in src/services/event-store/openapi.yaml.

claimId.description: Canonical claim_number; matches the ontology and the gold_claims data, e.g. CA-2026-0000123.

schemaVersion.description: Event-contract major version. v1 for the alpha.

payloadSchemaRef.description: URI of the payload schema in event-payloads.schema.json (e.g. event-payloads.schema.json#/$defs/EstimateDrafted).

correlationId.description: Demo-run key; groups a run for deterministic replay/reset, e.g. demo-run-001.

eventId.description: Server-assigned on append; do not set on publish.

sequenceNumber.description: Server-assigned append order within the claim stream.

payload.description: Validated against the eventType's schema in event-payloads.schema.json.
